ei.title: Reading as a Loosely Related Set of Behaviors
ei.subject: 10월_2024 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Reading as a Loosely Related Set of Behaviors

fullPassage: Some people argue that there is a single, logically consistent concept known as reading that can be neatly set apart from everything else people do with books. Is reading really that simple? The most productive way to think about reading is as a loosely related set of behaviors that belong together owing to family resemblances, as Ludwig Wittgenstein used the phrase, without having in common a single defining trait. Consequently, efforts to distinguish reading from nonreading are destined to fail because there is no agreement on what qualifies as reading in the first place. The more one tries to figure out where the border lies between reading and not-reading, the more edge cases will be found to stretch the term's flexible boundaries. Thus, it is worth attempting to collect together these exceptional forms of reading into a single forum, one highlighting the challenges faced by anyone wishing to establish the boundaries where reading begins and ends. The attempt moves toward an understanding of reading as a spectrum that is expansive enough to accommodate the distinct reading activities.

det.korean: (A) resemblances=개념적 유사성(가족 유사성 철학 개념), (B) resemblances=외적 닮음(쌍둥이의 외모)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 외모 — (B) 유사점: (A)는 외모가 아닌 개념적 유사성
✅ ② (A) 유사성 — (B) 외적 닮음: (A)는 비트겐슈타인의 가족 유사성 개념, (B)는 쌍둥이의 신체적 닮음 ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 관계 — (B) 차이점: resemblance에 관계/차이 의미 없음
❌ ④ (A) 공통점 — (B) 외모: (A)는 공통점보다 유사성이 정확
det.tip: (A) family resemblances = 가족 유사성(철학 개념) vs (B) physical resemblances = 외적 닮음

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "certain to happen; unavoidable"

det.korean: destined=운명지어진: 반드시 일어나게 되어 있는, 피할 수 없는
det.analysis:
❌ ① flexible: flexible(유연한)은 적응 가능성이지 불가피성이 아님
❌ ② productive: productive(생산적인)는 성과에 관한 것이지 운명이 아님
✅ ③ destined: destined(운명지어진)는 영영 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ exceptional: exceptional(예외적인)은 특별함이지 불가피성이 아님
det.tip: destined = certain to happen = 운명지어진

questions.passage: Consequently, efforts to __________ (distinction) reading from nonreading are destined to fail because there is no agreement on what qualifies as reading in the first place.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: distinction → distinguish: to 부정사 뒤에 동사원형 필요
det.analysis: efforts to __________ (distinction) — to 부정사 구조이므로 명사 distinction을 동사 distinguish로 변환 필요
det.tip: efforts to distinguish — to 부정사 + 동사원형

questions.passage: The attempt moves toward an __________ (understand) of reading as a spectrum that is expansive enough to accommodate the distinct reading activities.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: understand → understanding: 관사 an 뒤에 명사 필요
det.analysis: an __________ (understand) — 관사 an 뒤에 명사가 필요. 동사 understand를 명사 understanding으로 변환
det.tip: an understanding of — 관사 + 명사. ~에 대한 이해

questions.passage: Some people argue that there is a single, logically consistent concept known as reading that can be neatly set apart from everything else people do with books. Is reading really that simple? The most productive way to think about reading is as a loosely related set of behaviors that belong together owing to __________, as Ludwig Wittgenstein used the phrase, without having in common a single defining trait. Consequently, efforts to distinguish reading from nonreading are destined to fail because there is no agreement on what qualifies as reading in the first place. The more one tries to figure out where the border lies between reading and not-reading, the more edge cases will be found to stretch the term's flexible boundaries. Thus, it is worth attempting to collect together these exceptional forms of reading into a single forum, one highlighting the challenges faced by anyone wishing to establish the boundaries where reading begins and ends. The attempt moves toward an understanding of reading as a spectrum that is expansive enough to accommodate the distinct reading activities.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: family resemblances=가족 유사성 (비트겐슈타인이 사용한 용어로, 하나의 공통 특성 없이 함께 속하는 행동들)
det.analysis:
❌ ① flexible boundaries: 유연한 경계는 읽기 범위를 설명하지만 행동 간 관계는 아님
❌ ② edge cases: 경계 사례는 범위 확장 맥락이지 행동 간 관계가 아님
✅ ③ family resemblances: 원문 일치. 'owing to family resemblances' ←정답
❌ ④ defining trait: 정의적 특성은 오히려 없다고 말하는 것 — 맥락과 모순
det.tip: owing to family resemblances — 가족 유사성 덕분에
